qualification.development: Same exposed100 development questions, 100 corpus identities and94 declared families. All1600 cells were preregistered new-store repeats. The same development set informed earlier experiments; no independent confirmation, confidence interval or superiority claim.
qualification.scoring: Native LongMemEval rubric and contains-yes decision with Gateway GPT-4o alias and16 output tokens. No pinned model snapshot, native10-token protocol reproduction or full-set score.
qualification.comparisons: Matched retrieval pairs use the identical reader profile and96000-byte/top100 caps. Contract pairs keep retrieval, exact question/context message bytes and model settings fixed, changing only the system answer instruction/profile identity. Outcomes are descriptive paired observations from one execution per distinct request.
qualification.answerability: Seven abstention and93 non-abstention questions, classified by selected native manifest IDs ending in _abs, matching the importer. No question text, gold labels or per-question outcomes are published.
qualification.cost: Incremental totals follow the six actual receipts across model stages and count unique physical requests once. Per-stage and arm attributed costs overlap shared judge requests and cannot be summed as new spend. All known usage; no unresolved reservations added. Provider invoice reconciliation is outside this receipt audit.
qualification.latency: Receipt wall time includes each qualification/main phase; physical and arm service-time statistics are inherited from the pinned authenticated reports, not remeasured or reauthenticated against raw captures.
